description: This is a PHP unit test class for the VacancyAttachmentAPI in the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM project. It tests various API endpoints such as getAll, getOne, create, update, and delete for vacancy attachments, utilizing mock services and test data providers.

classes.name: VacancyAttachmentAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing VacancyAttachmentAPI endpoints, including create, retrieve, update, and delete operations for vacancy attachments.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the getAll method of the API, expects a NotImplemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for the getAll API endpoint, expects a NotImplemented exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a vacancy attachment with valid test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testCreate method from a YAML data source.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single vacancy attachment with valid test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testGetOne method from a YAML data source.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a vacancy attachment with valid test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testUpdate method from a YAML data source.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a vacancy attachment with valid test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testDelete method from a YAML data source.
